name: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Ltd
business_description: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Ltd operates as a small finance bank in India, providing banking and financial services primarily to unbanked and underbanked customers. The company earns revenue mainly through interest income from loans and advances, as well as fees from deposit and transaction services.
input_sensitivity: Cost risks: The company's margins are sensitive to changes in interest rates (cost of funds), regulatory compliance costs, and employee expenses. Revenue/demand risks: Demand is directly driven by the economic health and credit appetite of the unbanked and underbanked population, as well as broader macroeconomic factors affecting small businesses and rural households.
output_note: Individual customers and small businesses directly pay Suryoday Small Finance Bank for loans, deposit accounts, and related banking services.
